title: Colossians Chapter 4 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Colossians chapter 4 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Colossians Chapter 4 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Colossians Chapter 4.

questions.question: In Colossians 4, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal
Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving
Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time
Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt
questions.correctAnswer: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal
questions.explanation: This command appears first in Colossians 4:1.

questions.question: According to Colossians 4:1, who do masters have as a master themselves?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 states that masters know they also have a master in heaven.

questions.question: What does Colossians 4:2 instruct believers to continue in?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 commands to continue in prayer.

questions.question: What attitude should accompany watching according to Colossians 4:2?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 says to watch with thanksgiving.

questions.question: For what does Paul ask others to pray in Colossians 4:3?
options: That God would open a door of utterance
That God would increase their faith
That God would heal the sick
That God would send more teachers
questions.correctAnswer: That God would open a door of utterance
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 asks for prayer that God would open a door of utterance to speak the mystery of Christ.

questions.question: What is Paul in, as mentioned in Colossians 4:3?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 states Paul is in bonds while speaking of the mystery of Christ.

questions.question: What does Paul want to make manifest, as he ought to speak, according to Colossians 4:4?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:4 states Paul wants to make manifest the mystery of Christ as he ought to speak.

questions.question: How should believers walk toward them that are without, according to Colossians 4:5?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5 instructs to walk in wisdom toward those that are without.

questions.question: What does Paul say to do with time in Colossians 4:5?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5 commands to redeem the time.

questions.question: How should your speech be, according to Colossians 4:6?
options: Always with grace, seasoned with salt
questions.correctAnswer: Always with grace, seasoned with salt
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:6 says speech should always be with grace, seasoned with salt.

questions.question: Why should your speech be seasoned with salt, according to Colossians 4:6?
options: So that you may know how to answer every man
So that people will respect you
So that you will be understood
So that you will be heard
questions.correctAnswer: So that you may know how to answer every man
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:6 explains seasoning speech with salt is so you may know how to answer every man.

questions.question: Masters are instructed to give to their servants what is just and equal.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 instructs masters to give to their servants that which is just and equal.

questions.question: Believers are told to continue in prayer and watch with thanksgiving.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 commands believers to continue in prayer and watch with thanksgiving.

questions.question: Paul asks for prayer that God would grant wealth and health to the believers.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 specifically asks for prayer that God would open a door of utterance to speak the mystery of Christ, not for wealth or health.

questions.question: Colossians 4 says believers should walk in pride toward those outside the church.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5 instructs to walk in wisdom toward them that are without, not in pride.

medium.title: Colossians Chapter 4 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Colossians Chapter 4 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Who is described as a beloved brother and faithful minister in Colossians 4:7?
questions.explanation: Tychicus is referred to as a beloved brother and faithful minister in Colossians 4:7.

questions.question: What does Colossians 4:8 promise will happen if someone continues in prayer, as stated in Colossians 4:2?
options: They will know the will of God
They will receive a door of utterance
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:8 states that Tychicus is sent to comfort their hearts, which connects back to the call to prayer in Colossians 4:2.

questions.question: Who is accompanying Tychicus in delivering the message?
questions.explanation: Onesimus is mentioned as accompanying Tychicus in Colossians 4:9.

questions.question: What does Colossians 4:10 advise regarding Marcus?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:10 instructs the recipients to receive Marcus if he comes to them.

questions.question: What is the role of Jesus, who is called Justus, as stated in Colossians 4:11?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:11 describes Jesus, called Justus, as a fellow worker in the kingdom of God.

questions.question: What does Colossians 4:12 say about Epaphras?
options: He is a servant of Christ
questions.correctAnswer: He is a servant of Christ
questions.explanation: Epaphras is identified as a servant of Christ in Colossians 4:12.

questions.question: How should one's speech be, according to Colossians 4:6?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:6 instructs believers that their speech should always be with grace.

questions.question: What does Colossians 4:3 request regarding prayer for those in bonds?
options: To pray for open doors of utterance
questions.correctAnswer: To pray for open doors of utterance
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 asks for prayers for God to open a door of utterance for the mystery of Christ.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Tychicus's visit according to Colossians 4:8?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:8 states that Tychicus is sent to comfort their hearts.

questions.question: What is emphasized about the relationship between masters and servants in Colossians 4:1?
options: Masters should be just and equal
questions.correctAnswer: Masters should be just and equal
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 emphasizes that masters should give their servants what is just and equal.

questions.question: What does Colossians 4:5 suggest about how to interact with those outside the faith?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5 advises believers to walk in wisdom toward those who are outside.

questions.question: What is the expected outcome of Epaphras's fervent prayers as mentioned in Colossians 4:12?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:12 states that Epaphras prays that they may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

questions.question: True or False: Tychicus is described as a faithful minister in Colossians 4:7.
questions.explanation: Tychicus is indeed described as a faithful minister in Colossians 4:7.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 4:2 emphasizes the importance of prayer and thanksgiving.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 emphasizes the importance of continuing in prayer, but does not explicitly mention thanksgiving.

questions.question: True or False: Onesimus is mentioned as one of the faithful brothers in Colossians 4:9.
questions.explanation: Onesimus is mentioned as a beloved brother, but the term 'faithful' is not explicitly used in Colossians 4:9.

hard.title: Colossians Chapter 4 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Colossians Chapter 4.

questions.question: Who does Paul bear record of having a great zeal for the Colossians and others in nearby cities?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:13 states, 'For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis,' referring to Epaphras mentioned in the previous verse.

questions.question: Which two individuals are specifically mentioned as greeting the Colossians in verse 14?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:14 says, 'Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.'

questions.question: To whom does Paul instruct the Colossians to send greetings along with the church in his house?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:15 instructs, 'Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.'

questions.question: What does Paul instruct the Colossians to do with the epistle when it is read among them?
options: Cause it to be read also in the church of the Laodiceans
questions.correctAnswer: Cause it to be read also in the church of the Laodiceans
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:16 states, 'And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.'

questions.question: What specific charge does Paul give to Archippus in Colossians 4:17?
options: Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received
Travel to Laodicea with this letter
Care for the poor in Hierapolis
questions.correctAnswer: Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:17 says, 'And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.'

questions.question: What does Paul request the Colossians to remember in his salutation?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:18 includes Paul's salutation, 'Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.'

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'ὑπηρέτης' (hupēretēs) in Colossians 4:12 mean?
questions.explanation: In Colossians 4:12, Epaphras is described as 'a servant of Christ.' The Greek word 'ὑπηρέτης' (hupēretēs) commonly means 'servant' or 'minister,' indicating his devoted service.

questions.question: Which literary technique is prominently used in Colossians 4:2 where believers are urged to 'continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving'?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 uses parallelism by pairing 'continue in prayer' with 'watch in the same with thanksgiving,' showing balanced and rhythmic instruction.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage connects with the theme of masters and servants being just as in Colossians 4:1?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 commands masters to give servants what is just and equal, echoing Deuteronomy 24:14-15, which commands just treatment and prompt payment to servants or hired workers.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the instruction in Colossians 4:6 to let speech be 'with grace, seasoned with salt'?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:29 instructs believers to speak only what is helpful for building others up, aligning with Colossians 4:6's emphasis on speech with grace and salt, meaning speech should be gracious and wise.

questions.question: What comes immediately before Paul's statement about Epaphras' zeal in Colossians 4:13?
options: A description of Epaphras as a servant of Christ
A prayer request for open doors
questions.correctAnswer: A description of Epaphras as a servant of Christ
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:12 precedes verse 13 by describing Epaphras 'who is one of you, a servant of Christ,' setting the context for Paul's testimony of his zeal in verse 13.

questions.question: In the context of Colossians 4, what is the typological significance of Onesimus mentioned in verse 9?
options: He represents the transformed slave who becomes a brother in Christ
He is a symbol of Old Testament priesthood
He fulfills the role of a prophet like Moses
He is an example of a false teacher
questions.correctAnswer: He represents the transformed slave who becomes a brother in Christ
questions.explanation: Onesimus, a former slave, is called a 'faithful and beloved brother' in Colossians 4:9, illustrating the Christian typology of transformation and reconciliation, similar to the story in Philemon.

questions.question: How does the Greek word 'ζῆλος' (zēlos) used in Colossians 4:13 contribute to understanding Epaphras' character?
options: Indicates fervent zeal or passionate commitment
questions.correctAnswer: Indicates fervent zeal or passionate commitment
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'ζῆλος' in Colossians 4:13 signifies passionate zeal or fervent commitment, highlighting Epaphras' intense dedication for the believers.

questions.question: Is the instruction to Archippus in Colossians 4:17 an example of a charge to fulfill ministry duties?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:17 explicitly says, 'Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it,' clearly charging Archippus to fulfill his ministry duties.

questions.question: Does Paul conclude the letter in Colossians 4 without mentioning his bonds or imprisonment?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:18 includes Paul's salutation where he says, 'Remember my bonds,' indicating he does mention his imprisonment.

theological.title: Colossians Chapter 4 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Colossians Chapter 4 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 4:1 teach about the relationship between earthly authority and divine authority?
options: Earthly masters have ultimate authority independent of God
Servants owe obedience only to earthly masters, not to God
Earthly masters must act justly because they have a Master in heaven
Divine authority is irrelevant to social relationships
questions.correctAnswer: Earthly masters must act justly because they have a Master in heaven
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 teaches that masters should give to their servants what is just and equal, recognizing that they too have a Master in heaven, indicating earthly authority is subordinate to divine authority.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning prayer and thanksgiving is taught in Colossians 4:2?
options: Prayer is optional and separate from thanksgiving
Believers should continue steadfastly in prayer with thanksgiving
Thanksgiving is only for answered prayers
Prayer should be private and without thanksgiving
questions.correctAnswer: Believers should continue steadfastly in prayer with thanksgiving
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 instructs believers to continue in prayer and watch in the same with thanksgiving, teaching the doctrine of persistent prayer coupled with gratefulness.

questions.question: What doctrine about the proclamation of the gospel is taught in Colossians 4:3?
options: The gospel mystery should be kept secret
Believers should pray for open opportunities to speak the mystery of Christ
The gospel is irrelevant to those outside the church
Preaching is only for those in comfortable circumstances
questions.correctAnswer: Believers should pray for open opportunities to speak the mystery of Christ
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 emphasizes the need for prayer that God would open a door of utterance to speak the mystery of Christ, highlighting the importance of gospel proclamation.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Colossians 4:1 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 shows God's sovereignty because earthly masters are reminded that they have a Master in heaven, indicating God's ultimate authority over all.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is exhibited in Colossians 4:6 by instructing believers to let their speech be 'with grace, seasoned with salt'?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:6 reflects God's wisdom as believers are urged to speak graciously and wisely to know how to answer everyone.

questions.question: How does Colossians 4:5's instruction to 'walk in wisdom toward them that are without' connect to the broader biblical theme of Christian witness?
options: It reflects the biblical call to evangelize with discernment and prudence
It suggests believers should conform to worldly customs
It teaches that Christians should avoid contact with outsiders
questions.correctAnswer: It reflects the biblical call to evangelize with discernment and prudence
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5 links to the biblical theme of wise, prudent witness to non-believers, preparing the way for effective evangelism as seen in broader Scripture.

questions.question: In what way does Colossians 4:16's instruction to read the epistle among the Laodiceans relate to the New Testament practice of epistle circulation?
options: It shows that letters were private and not shared
It illustrates early church practice of mutual edification through shared letters
It commands exclusive reading only within Colossae
It discourages reading letters from other churches
questions.correctAnswer: It illustrates early church practice of mutual edification through shared letters
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:16 demonstrates the early Christian practice of sharing epistles between churches for mutual edification, connecting to the narrative arc of apostolic instruction.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Colossians 4:2 and 4:12 teach about the role of prayer in sanctification?
options: Prayer is irrelevant for spiritual maturity
Persistent prayer with thanksgiving and fervent intercession are essential for standing complete in God's will
Prayer is only for personal needs, not for others
Prayer must be silent and private to be effective
questions.correctAnswer: Persistent prayer with thanksgiving and fervent intercession are essential for standing complete in God's will
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 commands continuing in prayer with thanksgiving, and 4:12 describes Epaphras laboring fervently in prayer for believers to stand perfect and complete in God's will, emphasizing prayer's sanctifying role.

questions.question: What doctrine about Christian ministry is taught by the combination of Colossians 4:17 and 4:18?
options: Ministry is optional and without accountability
Ministers must be faithful in fulfilling their calling despite hardship
Ministry is primarily for personal gain
Ministry should avoid suffering and bonds
questions.correctAnswer: Ministers must be faithful in fulfilling their calling despite hardship
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:17 instructs Archippus to take heed to his ministry and fulfill it, while 4:18 references Paul's bonds, illustrating faithfulness in ministry amid suffering.

questions.question: What theological synthesis do Colossians 4:3 and 4:4 provide about the proclamation of Christ's mystery?
options: The mystery of Christ is to be kept hidden
Believers pray for open speech to manifest the mystery of Christ as they ought
Proclamation is unnecessary because the mystery is already known
The mystery of Christ is only for select individuals
questions.correctAnswer: Believers pray for open speech to manifest the mystery of Christ as they ought
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 and 4:4 together teach the necessity of prayer for open opportunity and the responsibility to rightly manifest the mystery of Christ in proclamation.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Colossians 4:5-6 teaches Christians should manipulate outsiders with clever speech. What does this passage actually teach?
options: Christians should walk in wisdom and speak with grace to rightly answer others
Christians must use deceit to convert unbelievers
Speech should be harsh to show authority
questions.correctAnswer: Christians should walk in wisdom and speak with grace to rightly answer others
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5-6 teaches walking in wisdom toward outsiders and speaking with grace, seasoned with salt, so believers know how to answer every person properly, not manipulation.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning Christian fellowship and mutual encouragement is emphasized in Colossians 4:7-9?
options: Christian fellowship is unnecessary for spiritual growth
Fellow believers serve as faithful ministers and comfort one another
Only apostles can comfort the church
Ministers should work independently without contact
questions.correctAnswer: Fellow believers serve as faithful ministers and comfort one another
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:7-9 highlights Tychicus and Onesimus as beloved brothers and faithful ministers sent to comfort and inform the Colossians, underscoring mutual encouragement.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is reflected in Colossians 4:12 regarding Epaphras' fervent labor in prayer for the saints?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:12 describes Epaphras as always laboring fervently in prayers for the believers, demonstrating the divine attribute of zeal in intercession.

questions.question: What theological theme is advanced by the mention of reading the epistle in both Colossae and Laodicea in Colossians 4:16?
options: The irrelevance of scripture in different congregations
The unity and interconnectedness of the early church through shared teaching
The exclusivity of local church instruction
The rejection of letters from other communities
questions.correctAnswer: The unity and interconnectedness of the early church through shared teaching
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:16 instructs that the letter be read in Laodicea and theirs read in Colossae, illustrating the early church's unity and mutual edification.

questions.question: What combined doctrine about Christian identity can be drawn from Colossians 4:9 and 4:11?
options: Christian identity is based solely on ethnic heritage
Faithful believers, regardless of background, are fellowworkers in God's kingdom
Only Jewish Christians are true coworkers
Fellowship is limited to those in prison with Paul
questions.correctAnswer: Faithful believers, regardless of background, are fellowworkers in God's kingdom
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:9 speaks of Onesimus as a faithful brother 'one of you,' and 4:11 mentions Justus and others of the circumcision as fellowworkers, showing that faithfulness defines Christian identity.
